definition: Identifiers carried by this entity, such as national ID numbers, program IDs, or identifiers asserted by an identity document.
The URI of the Metric this observation reports a value against.
The temporal coverage of this observation.

The ordered list of {dimension_uri, code} pairs that locate this observation in the metric's DSD. Ordering matches Metric.dimensions; every dimension declared on the Metric must have a value on every observation (W3C Data Cube integrity constraint IC-11).

The numeric value reported by this observation. Scale is fixed by Metric.unit and Metric.multiplier: for value_type proportion with unit unitless, the value is in 0..1; with unit PT, the value is in 0..100. The observation cannot override scale.
The list of {attribute_uri, value} pairs that decorate this observation, series, or dataset. When UNIT_MEASURE appears here, it must equal Metric.unit.
The URI of the MetricCalculation definition this observation realises.
Optional URI of an execution record (provenance: software agent, run timestamp, parameter set). Light PROV-O alignment recommended; full execution-provenance shape is deferred.
